correctness.rationale: For n>=6, the equivariant simplicial map replacing vertices 3 and n-2 by 1 and n respectively is contiguous to the identity and retracts onto the induced subcomplex deleting 3,n-2; for n=6 the two substitutions agree with distinct endpoints and remain valid. The residual graph is P2 disjoint union P_(n-6) disjoint union P2, so its independence complex is a three-factor join. Reversal interchanges the outer two S0 factors, which is the unit sphere of the swap R_+ plus R_- representation; the central factor carries shorter path reversal. Base cases n=1..5 supply the fixed/antipodal representation directions and contractible cases, giving the six-periodic a_n,b_n table and the equivariant homotopy classification. Passing to ordinary orbit spaces yields S^(a-1)*RP^(b-1), and integral projective homology gives first H3=Z/2 at n14 and arbitrarily many two-torsion degrees. Independent full-face quotient Euler checks for n<=16 agreed with representation prediction; Euler alone would not certify torsion, which follows from the structural equivariant map and projective cellular chains.
